training_mixture: 50% clean; 25% circular AWGN uniformly at 0/5/10/15/20 dB; 25% mild/severe multipath uniformly; epoch-dependent deterministic draw
checkpoint_selection: unchanged: maximum clean validation recording macro-F1 then minimum clean validation loss
comparison: all 40 previously frozen validation stress conditions, all three paired model seeds and each ensemble
